match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
partial def leaves : Formula → List String
  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
  | _ => []

def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length

  2000 ms; every scenario is judged at t1 = 1000 ms (the `window`). Occupancy is derived from the
  geometry (the user's position inside the rectangle).
  - holds: x at (15, 0) at t0 (on r), at (25, 0) at t1 and (35, 0) at t2 (off r).

import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Formals ↦ regions: r ↦ 100  (a structure of every trace)

    parameters. -/

  { name := "drv.motion.leaving_region@w"
    concept := "drv.motion.leaving_region"
    literals := []
    nats := []
    params := []
    bounds := none
  }

def instances : List Concept.Instance := [inst]

def regionR : Structure := Build.rect 100 .lane (m 0) (m (-2)) (m 20) (m 2)

  , witness "fails" failsTrace .violated
